newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money rates steady to easier in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: HK money rates steady to easier in thin trade.

text.p: Interbank rates were steady to easier on Monday in very thin trading ahead of the Christmas holidays, dealers said.
"There was almost no dealing at all this morning and traders were just staying on the sidelines," a European bank dealer said. The market is closed on Wednesday and Thursday.
Overnight money stood at 4-1/2 3/8 percent at midday on Monday against its 5 4-3/8 percent close on Friday. Three-month money was little changed at 5-9/16 7/16 against 5-9/16 1/2.
Short term money remained very liquid as many players had prepared funding for the whole of December ahead of the start of the real-time gross settlement (RTGS) earlier this month, dealers said.
Government paper trade was very quiet after prices opened a touch lower on back of easier U.S. treasuries, dealers said.
One-month yields gained two basis points to 4.35 percent.
Three-year note yields rose to 6.11 percent from 6.08, the seven-year yields edged up five basis points to 7.11 and the longest 10-year note yielded 7.35 versus 7.31 percent.
